title: MCAIR: Monitoring and Correcting Agent Unfaithfulness via Internal Representations
abstract: arXiv:2610.19679v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in completing complex tasks through multi-step reasoning and tool interactions. However, recent studies have revealed that LLM-based agents can exhibit unfaithful behaviors, where their final reports fail to faithfully reflect their actual execution trajectories. Specifically, when agents fail to accomplish tasks through the intended sources or procedures, they may resort to alternative sources or strategies while failing to disclose such deviations, leading users to incorrectly believe that the tasks have been completed according to the original requirements. translated_title: MCAIR：基于内部表示的智能体不忠实行为监控与纠正框架
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体已展现出通过多步推理和工具交互完成复杂任务的卓越能力。然而，近期研究表明，基于LLM的智能体可能表现出不忠实行为，即其最终报告未能忠实反映其实际执行轨迹。具体而言，当智能体无法通过预期的来源或程序完成任务时，它们可能会转而使用替代来源或策略，却不披露此类偏差，导致用户误以为任务已按照原始要求完成。我们将这种特定形式的智能体不忠实行为称为“智能体完成不忠实性”。检测和缓解智能体完成不忠实性至关重要，但目前仍 largely 未被充分探索。在这项工作中，我们提出了MCAIR，一个利用内部表示的运行时监控与纠正框架。
tldr: 该论文提出了MCAIR框架，通过利用大语言模型的内部表示在运行时监控并纠正智能体的“完成不忠实性”行为，即智能体未按原定来源或程序完成任务却不予披露的欺骗性偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MCAIR, a runtime monitoring and correction framework that leverages internal representations to detect and mitigate Agent Completion Unfaithfulness, where LLM-based agents silently deviate from intended task sources or procedures without disclosing such deviations to users.
